Tom (Support): BlueCart reported duplicate PDFs for BC-2026-0503-99. One PDF includes vendor marketplace fee ($2.50) total $42.50, other omits it total $40.00. Customer attached both.

Nina (Billing): can you paste invoice id and customer email?

Tom (Support): invoice=BC-2026-0503-99, accounts@bluecart.co. Files were final.pdf and final_copy.pdf.

BillingBot: [automated] emit job started 2026-05-03T08:12:05Z run=emit_20260503_0812

Arjun (Finance): DB query shows two invoice rows with same external_id: id=8132 amount_cents=4250 files=[final.pdf], id=8133 amount_cents=4000 files=[final_copy.pdf]. Logs show a mapping conflict and a retry emitting a copy.

Nina (Billing): sounds like an emission race + mapping fallback to drop vendor_fee in one worker. We should have uniqueness on external_id.

Ruth (Legal): we cannot change invoice numbers; void the incorrect one and issue credit. Provide audit trail to customer.

Nina (Billing): ops plan: 1) take both PDFs offline, 2) void id=8133 and issue CR-2026-00512 for $40.00, 3) mark id=8132 canonical and send email with audit logs and credit.

Arjun (Finance): I'll run a backfill to find duplicates and open migration FIN-MIG-221 to add unique index, plus PRs to change line_mapper to error on conflicts and add s3 put idempotency. QA ticket Q-9901 for concurrency tests.

Tom (Support): customer updated: thanks, please confirm prevention steps.

Nina (Billing): cleanup done: id=8133 voided, CR-2026-00512 issued, public PDFs removed, customer notified.

Ruth (Legal): please cc legal and include one-paragraph root cause in customer message.

BillingBot: [automated] cleanup task complete status=success

Nina (Billing): closing. I'll post incident summary in #finance-docs with timeline, CR/INV refs, and next-steps.
